<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Gluttonous Geode](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2624)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Gluttonous geodes form when natural forces crack open a geode that's steeped in elemental magic, causing a natural break that acts like a hinged jaw. Though seemingly unimportant and no larger than a common turtle, gluttonous geodes are bellicose and dogged in their pursuit of an enemy.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Gluttonous Geode](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2624)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tiny" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 104

**Perception** +6; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +4, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** -1

**Con** +3

**Int** -4

**Wis** +1

**Cha** -3
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 15 

**Fort** +8 

**Ref** +4 

**Will** +6 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 25

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
crystal teeth +9,
**Damage** 1d4+4 piercing plus Attach

**Attach** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The geode Leaps up to 15 feet and makes a crystal teeth Strike. If it hits a creature larger than itself, it can attach to that creature. Doing so is like [Grabbing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=18) the creature ([Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) DC 17), but the geode moves with that creature rather than holding it in place. The geode is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) while attached. If the geode is killed or [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) away while attached to a creature, that creature takes 1 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). Escaping the attached geode or removing the geode in other ways doesn't cause bleed damage.

**Gnaw** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Requirements** The geode is attached to a creature; **Effect** The geode deals 1d4+2 bludgeoning damage to the creature it's attached to (DC 17 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save).

</column>
